sceneConcept: A provisional design for a forty-three-year-old Chinese fugitive researcher stands alone against a transparent background. Uneven self-trimmed black hair greys at the temples, while brown eyes, deep under-eye shadows and several days of stubble show prolonged flight. He wears a desaturated graphite hooded field coat over a black turtleneck, dark cargo trousers, worn combat boots and one plain charcoal messenger bag. His arms are crossed and his weight leans slightly forward, expressing exhausted but unyielding conviction. Soft even frontal studio light keeps every element ordinary and replaceable if later canon appears. Visual refresh: anonymous layered technical clothing with a mouth mask and isolated terminal harness.
